notes.title: Factions of the Barkhan World: Part 7, in Crimson Tone. Base arrangement 3
notes.content:
Well, why are you just standing there, staring? Let's move on and expand your horizons. The Baron himself ordered to continue your journey into the world of knowledge. So...


Wow! That was powerful. Glory to the Baron! Hey, why are you glued to the ground? Don't be afraid, it's just our bird. Brand new, not dusty, fresh out of the 'nest', or rather from the aviation factory.

Let's get closer, you'll see the process in more detail and see for yourself that our Baron is the wisest, and his ideas are the embodiment of perfection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/07b2dc145ab3761ee58062d023a062583c717087.gif[/img]

Right here, in the holy of holies, our hawks are created, which rightfully dominate the skies on this, and any other planet. The sound of their turbines makes the enemy's blood run cold, causing awe and paralysis. And those wings? Notice how the light reflects off the polished metal, blinding. And under favorable weather conditions, it can even incinerate. Haha. This too is a brilliant idea from our brightest minds.

By the way, about the turbines. Do you hear that hum? That’s the turbine of our power plant spinning. Let's take a closer look, today the radiation is minimal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/4c592328e03fdb6810ac45f2e2d8bfd7fffaba01.gif[/img]

These huge turbines bring light and joy to every home. Thanks to their continuous operation, electricity flows to factories and plants, allowing us to create the unprecedented and the superior.

And also, although it's obvious that your imagination has already been struck, during their operation the turbines draw in the tiniest water particles. As you know, water is a rare guest on this sandy planet, so we collect every last drop. And our wisest Baron gives us instructions on how to use it rationally and wisely. Oh, there is no limit to His genius!

You already know a lot about the power and technology of our House, but believe me, there is much more to come. It’s commendable that you grasp the essence quickly, it’s not for nothing that the wisest Baron chose you. Be proud of it and don’t forget.

Now go and tell everyone about the greatness of our House, the progenitor of progress, the citadel of safety.

notes.title: Factions of the Barkhan World: Part 6, in Crimson Tone. Base arrangement 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/932739e0373819ad17cd203f286e24aced29b00a.jpg[/img]

Continuing our journey through our domains, I will show you a few more key objects that reflect the power and grandeur of our House. Watch closely and don't blink in astonishment, for what you will see is not for mere mortals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/1881cd738c0a9070ed88a9b3236a469850cbf83d.gif[/img]
This is our Refinery. Here, thousands of tons of valuable resources harvested by our collectors are processed. The refinery not only processes resources but also stores them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/dcd644a804d55cddad3bc29885755f7a9141351e.gif[/img]
To increase storage capacity, additional storage facilities can be built. It is astonishing how the technological sophistication of this complex allows us to preserve even the smallest grains of valuable resources. These high-precision processes transform raw materials into power, which strengthens our House and makes it invincible. Here, every action, every mechanism serves the great purpose of maintaining and multiplying the influence of our House.

Only the wisdom of our great Baron and his humble, loyal advisor allows the House to be elevated to such heights. Remember this, for such grandeur is beyond the understanding of mere mortals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/4fb073a55ec2ad4277ed400262091156229a4a6e.gif[/img]
Now let's move on to the next structure. This is our Technical Center, where the best minds of humanity work. Here, new technologies are created, ensuring our superiority over enemies.

Thanks to these discoveries, we have the latest models of weaponry, modern equipment, and super-powerful weapons that make our House invincible.

Look at this place and understand that every discovery here is another brick in strengthening our invincibility. Think about the significance of this work for our great House and the great merit of the wise Baron, thanks to whom these achievements become possible.

notes.title: Factions of the Barkhan World: Part 5, in Crimson Tone. Base arrangement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/4d3bab21ce3a8a684273ba108dbe83fdb8cf09d4.jpg[/img]

Rise and shine, maggot!

Today is a glorious day when all your trials are completed, and our great lord, the Baron, has allowed me to give you an introductory tour.  
I will show you the main structures created by the best architects and engineers of our House.  
You are incredibly lucky - not everyone gets such an honor. Many of your predecessors did not live to see this day. You will witness the grandeur and power of our domains, so you can later tell your less intelligent friends about what you saw. Well, let's begin...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/700641db5b3a0b31fb21a6bc909ca5bf619f5129.gif[/img]

This is our Construction Center. It is here that the construction, launch, and setup of all production, research, and other buildings are initiated and controlled. Remember this place, for here you can hear the powerful heartbeat of the House.  
Just take a look. The technical magnificence of this structure is breathtaking. Every detail, every machine is the product of the labor and genius of the finest minds. Impressive, isn't it? Here every corner is imbued with the might of our great House.

While we move to the next structure, be inspired by the grandeur and power of this place. Here everyone, just like you, serves the sole purpose of strengthening our power and glory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/590cd38bcbd2f0d2aba6955f19450f25fafc91cb.gif[/img]

Look! These are the Barracks where the elite infantry of the House is trained. Training here is a test of strength, endurance, and loyalty. Only the chosen, the worthy, undergo full training and are honored to wear armor made of high-strength and unique material obtained from distant planets. This armor not only protects but also symbolizes the power and might of our House. They are an example of invincibility and a terrifying appearance.  
The training process in the Barracks is brutal and ruthless. Every recruit goes through the hell of rigorous training, where not only physical abilities but also mental resilience are tested. Only the best of the best come out of here ready for battle, capable of instilling fear and terror in anyone who dares to stand in our way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/197107eea218110ae51101deca0bd7350d6e7667.gif[/img]

Now let's move on to the next structure. Our Factory. Worthless slaves work around the clock, providing us with both light machinery and terrifying war chariots capable of crushing any despicable enemies. Within these walls, the combat power that instills fear in our adversaries is born. Pay attention to the continuity of work and discipline - it is thanks to them that each unit of equipment leaves here ready for battle, embodying the strength and invincibility of our House.

notes.title: Factions of the Barkhan World: Part 4, in Crimson Tone. Special
notes.content:
Today's review will focus on specialized military equipment designed to carry out special tasks on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/94378ffa288afb4ee0b96428738e911483b36a8b.gif[/img]

First on the list is the "Eradicator," a deadly artillery system that outstrips all competitors in its class in terms of firing range. This formidable machine was conceived before the onset of the conflict. Its development was frozen for a long time, but was revived due to the demands of wartime. The original concept was so successful that even years later, it did not become outdated. This allowed the "Eradicator" to integrate components from other, more modern technology, such as a powerful three thousand horsepower engine from a storm tank and a transmission from the "Behemoth" assault transport.

The most challenging part was the development of ammunition. Modern warfare has pushed enemies in technological progress. The destructive power of obsolete shells was deemed insufficient. Thanks to modern armor, even infantrymen did not receive fatal damage from the explosion of these munitions. The ammunition for the "Eradicator" has been reworked. They are now equipped with an individual target guidance system, have a higher speed, and are equipped with a more powerful charge.

The weapon has been improved and equipped with an additional stabilization system when firing, but, due to the large recoil of the super-large caliber of the weapon, firing is impossible while the vehicle is moving. Therefore, the "Eradicator" is let down not only by its impressive dimensions and low maneuverability but also by the inability to counter the threat in firing mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/f5f1c19ad169e21eebe5caa1ce795c2575be4eef.png[/img]

Second in our review is the "Behemoth" - a heavy armored personnel carrier designed to protect and transport infantry. It is not armed. The main focus during development was on maximum protection of the landing party and crew. The armor plates are arranged in such a way that they provide all-round protection from most types of ammunition. Two powerful engines allow the "Behemoth" to continue moving even when one of them fails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/5a7554b00b040b8de2c208c3568dedd40a13cf4b.gif[/img]

Our review is completed by the "Spider" - a mobile radar system. It is capable of significantly expanding the radius of visibility and detecting camouflaged enemy units. The "Spider" can only function in a stationary state.

We will be back with the next story soon!

notes.title: Powerful Factions of the Barkhan World: Part 3, in Crimson Tone. Defense
notes.content:
The security of your base plays a pivotal role in the gameplay, and neglecting this aspect would be unwise. In doing so, you expose yourself not only to the risk of unexpected attacks on vulnerable rear areas but also to the danger of enemy diversions capable of destroying key structures on your territory.

Defensive structures, including walls and turrets, act as your reliable shield for defense and base development. When strategically positioned, they can effectively withstand even massive enemy attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/625c07c9cd7f2fc068c8218d0077fa880a99017c.gif[/img]

The crowning achievement of this faction's defensive technologies is the Monument – an impressive combat complex with a powerful energy generator. This colossal structure is equally effective against ground and aerial threats, capable of inflicting devastating damage upon enemy forces. The Monument's mighty energy beam can reduce light targets to ashes and effortlessly burn through heavy armor, turning enemy machinery into smoldering heaps of destroyed metal.

Countless years were dedicated to bringing the idea of this remarkable device to life. The journey from initial blueprints to realization was long and arduous, marked by numerous scientific research, failed prototypes, and critical development errors. As a result, the unique "Ecta Crystal" was discovered, becoming the heart of this behemoth.

To ensure the power and stability of the emitting mechanism, an extensive network of power stations is required. However, recharging such a powerful device takes a considerable amount of time, and the generator is capable of targeting only one enemy at a time.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/0c145f93df3dd3844fd93d455dba1f40bf5222cb.gif[/img]

In response to the challenge of countering attacks from a large number of lightly armored targets, a special type of defensive tower was developed. These towers are equipped with both machine guns and flamethrowers, offering a combined armament.

Thanks to their reliability and diverse weaponry, these turrets are indispensable elements of defensive strategy. Skillful placement of these turrets ensures the protection of key buildings and faction territory.

notes.title: Factions of the Barkhan World: Part 2, in Crimson Tone. Infantry
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/e5ad8799066536bec9eeb9bcd08d1eeb96730682.png[/img]
Today, we continue introducing you to the units of the faction we reviewed last time.

Its infantry rightfully deserves the title of Elite. They are the most protected of all the infantry units across all factions. Only a few survive ruthless multi-year training on planets harsh for life, and they can continue specialization. Many die during this training, others go mad from harsh training programs. Only the chosen ones have the great honor of wearing special ultra-protected armor, made from the rarest materials found on remote planets.

These are hardened warriors, fanatically loyal to their lord. With their self-preservation instinct reduced to a minimum, they become perfect fighters. These infantrymen unhesitatingly go into battle, crushing everything in their path.

The rigorous training and expensive gear of this elite infantry impact its numbers. The infantry has various specializations:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/0beb4be09c3aa24f79169abf8cd5a866aa5a7884.gif[/img]
"Aggressor" - trained to counter any ground technology, having a heavy grenade launcher in their arsenal.

"Redeemer" - a warrior with this specialization has a heavy machine gun in his arsenal, effective against infantry and airborne units.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/1f0658644c484b78eb1e4ba4631430d1b1b387e5.gif[/img]
"Spartan" - equipped with a unique melee weapon - energy daggers. They draw power from the ultra-capacity battery located at the back of the armored suit. This enhanced armor suit has turned the Spartan into a walking tank, which has adversely affected his maneuverability. Powerful servomotors can periodically speed up the movement of the armor, allowing for short-term bursts towards the target.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/58871365dbcc58490611c7677f4a70f5cf0e2203.gif[/img]
"Healer" - the bearer of this specialization is equipped with complex medical equipment. It is this equipment that allows for relatively quick healing of even severely wounded fighters right on the battlefield.

Stay with us and keep up with our news. We will continue to share information about the game world, various units, and the history of the universe.

notes.title: Factions of the Barkhan World: Part 1, in Crimson Tone
notes.content:
Welcome, friends!
Today we begin to introduce you to the warring factions of the world of "Barkhan".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/e5d0126a8651c108f4d31b4faa4cc28ff6585fe9.png[/img]

The first hero of our story is a faction that was introduced in the demo version of the game as an enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/e5ad8799066536bec9eeb9bcd08d1eeb96730682.png[/img]

Many of you have already seen them in action and have experienced the full power of their heavy armored vehicles.

So...
The approaching rumble and clatter of mighty caterpillars instill fear and trembling in the enemy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/9a2e77160aba89f4bf121d2bd578f541f15f6f06.gif[/img]
Volcano: this is a fast and maneuverable combat vehicle equipped with a twin large-caliber machine gun. An excellent choice for quick attacks and supporting the main forces on the battlefield.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/bc2cd34e040aeb65f7061334603a3267f461b5d7.gif[/img]
Inferno: this tank is equipped with two heavy flamethrowers and powerful armor. It's a formidable foe for lightly armored forces, especially for infantry, which it can turn to ashes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/386c75f3966a22c3069402beaa5226ca9698c365.gif[/img]
Minotaur: a gigantic tank comparable in size to a small rock, tops the list of the largest ground combat units. It is equipped with a personal nuclear reactor, which barely copes with providing energy for this monster. And its large-caliber weapons inflict colossal damage.


We will continue to tell you about this powerful faction and get you acquainted with their equipment, strategies, and features in more detail.

Stay tuned for our news, as this is only the first part of our story about the game world.

notes.title: We are postponing the game's release date.
notes.content:
We need time to raise the project to a level that will meet our standards and expectations.
We decided not to compromise. Yes, much has already been done, but more needs to be done.

We understand that there are things in the project that we can and should improve.

That's why our team decided to [b]postpone the game's release to July 2023[/b].

All this time, the development of the game is in full swing.

Soon we will start introducing you to the opposing factions, units, buildings, mechanics, the world and the essence of the game's conflict.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285284/85b3e120d92f4987fde2fd875373e7d55c3dce65.gif[/img]

notes.title: Barkhan - Steam Next Fest Official Livestream!
notes.content:
Barkhan is inspired by the classics, paying major homage to legendary games like Dune II: The Building of a Dynasty and Dune 2000, both genre-defining titles that set the standard for other real-time strategy games for years to come. Barkhan aims to deliver an experience reminiscent of the golden era of RTS, with a modern twist. Explore a world rendered in beautiful 3D, build and expand your base, train and prepare your armies, and clash in the battlefield to conquer your enemies. But be wary, more than a few surprises lie hidden beneath the sand.

While the game is still early in development, the team at Glyph Worlds wanted to use the Steam Next Fest as an opportunity to give players around the world the chance to try their new game and gather feedback.

Join the fight and rise to victory, only one can rule the desert!
